Scripts/Widgets/SharedResources/WidgetCo.summary: This file provides the base `Widget` class for managing widget instances, preferences, and lifecycle events in the project.

Scripts/Widgets/Navbar/navbar.js.summary: This file implements the `NavBar` widget class, which manages navigation bar data feeds, styling, and DOM regeneration. It serves as the frontend component for site navigation within the iWeb project.

.github/workflows/nextjs.yml.summary: This GitHub Actions workflow file automates building and deploying the Next.js site to GitHub Pages upon pushes to designated branches. It serves as the CI/CD pipeline for production web deployments.

app/anreise/page.tsx.summary: `app/anreise/page.tsx` renders the "Anreise" (Directions) view featuring a privacy-compliant interactive map loader. It exports the default `AnreisePage` component as a Next.js route page.

Scripts/iWebSite.js.summary: This file embeds the Prototype JavaScript framework (v1.6.0) to provide core utility functions and object-oriented class structures. It exports `Prototype` and `Class` to support client-side scripting across the iWeb project.

Scripts/iWebImage.js.summary: `Scripts/iWebImage.js` manages asynchronous image loading, caching, and lifecycle events for the iWeb project. It exports `IWImage`, `IWCreateImage`, `IWImageNamed`, and `IWRegisterNamedImage`.

app/datenschutz/page.tsx.summary: `app/datenschutz/page.tsx` renders the privacy policy page for the application. It exports the default component `DatenschutzPage` and a `metadata` object to fulfill legal data protection requirements.

app/fewo-105/badezimmer/page.tsx.summary: This Next.js page renders the bathroom details for Apartment 105 using `Badezimmer105Page` and `RoomPage`, serving as a specific room view within the vacation rental application.

app/fewo-105/balkon/page.tsx.summary: This file renders the balcony room page for Apartment 105 using `Balkon105Page`. It exports metadata and serves as a Next.js page component within the project.

app/fewo-105/wohnzimmer/page.tsx.summary: This file renders the living room detail page for Apartment 105 using `Wohnzimmer105Page` and `RoomPage`, serving as a specific room view within the application.

app/fewo-105/page.tsx.summary: This Next.js page renders the detailed view and metadata for apartment 105 using `ApartmentPageClient` and `Fewo105Page`. It serves as the main route for Ferienwohnung 105.

app/fewo-105/schlafzimmer/page.tsx.summary: This file renders the bedroom page for Apartment 105 using the `RoomPage` component. It exports the `Schlafzimmer105Page` component and page `metadata`.
